rationale: Otherwise clean file: build, blood pressure, A1c, tobacco, family history, occupation, driving, liver chemistry and financials all clear. The only adverse factor is lipids: total cholesterol falls in the top band and the ratio in the middle band, and the two tables disagree, so I used judgement. Stacking both would double-count one lab panel; with a protective HDL I charged the worse single band only. Total debits fall in the Table 2 band. Accept at Table 2, no modifiers.
